## What changed?

Describe the user problem and the smallest solution you chose.

## How was it checked?

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] User-facing changes are documented
- [ ] No API keys, private slides, transcripts, or generated images are included

## Simplicity check

Could a new contributor find the changed behavior, its test, and its docs without
knowing the whole codebase? Note any new setting and why a maintained default was
not enough.
